scope: Linux native game with software SDL; not Android GPU, phone FPS, battery or thermal measurements
ordering: Sequential ABBA per case; no overlapping builds or benchmarks
gap_quantiles: Upper bounds in fixed 0.1ms bins; overflow uses observed maximum
action_tape_note: Car uses the first 675 frames of the existing tape, all fixed-duration inputs; the conditional transformation section after frame 675 is not used by these 600-presentation runs.
harness_recovery: The first car invocation was rejected before runner launch because later unused entries in the full tape carry conditional metadata. Retained the completed eight Fuzzy runs after hash checks and used the unmodified fixed first four car actions for the eight car runs.
result_interpretation: PASS covers execution, native coverage, count consistency and identical final images. No general performance improvement threshold was met or claimed.
performance_limitations: Shared host with substantial run-to-run variation, including a candidate car-60 outlier retained in full.
The 16 runs are short desktop software-SDL samples, not sustained Android or phone measurements.
No attribution of the observed adverse outlier to a particular production change or to host interference was established.
Summary quantiles are medians of per-run quantile upper bounds, not pooled quantiles.
